entities.summary: Jan Gunnarsson is a former tennis player from Sweden, who won one singles title in Vienna in 1985 and nine doubles titles on the world tour during his professional career. In 1989 he reached the semi-finals of Australian Open where he lost in straight sets to Miloslav Mečíř.
